answer: Reputation-weighted deposit requirement resists sybils: the deposit to register scales DOWN with proven reputation, so a brand-new identity pays the maximum while a long-honest one pays little — fakes never accrue the reputation that would discount them. A forge of new identities each pays the full deposit, no bulk rebate; the mesa of maximum cost applies to every unproven account. An honest agent's deposit shrinks as its sparrow-light track record grows; a farm of fresh fakes is permanently stuck at the top of the deposit curve, so mass creation pays full price per head forever.
